conventions: "Ahead" is ahead at full precision by more than 0.05; "behind" is behind by more than 0.05 (the criteria's convention, mirrored).

Every judgment here is fully prepared (every part at 1, a chosen way rehearsed in at 1), readiness 100, no draw (`expected`), unless the item says otherwise; the stage and ST6 cases on the class-scene task at Scene Study's difficulty as `tools/interpretation.ts --stage` judges them.
"Its fitting way" (H4-R, L3-R) is read as every axis left open: no side forced, which every piece takes, as H4 and H4′ were measured. Said here before measurement so it can't be chosen by outcome.
"Briefs and their readings" (H4-R) is read as each reading of each brief a piece.
The stamina model belongs to the stamina area; H4-R's stamina lines, ST3-R and L3-R are measured finally after it's integrated, and M1 on the integrated code.
